title: Path traversal reads secrets and overwrites configuration
summary: A document reader and note writer join user-supplied names onto their base folders without checks, so '../' reads the API key and overwrites the app configuration. The secure twin resolves paths and rejects anything outside its folder.
credits: Pattern also exercised by MCPGoat (MIT) and the Appsecco vulnerable MCP servers lab (MIT); re-implemented, no code copied.
